hubbuy_account_reconciled.name: hubbuy_account_reconciled
hubbuy_account_reconciled.value: ("hubbuy_accounts"."status" = 'active' AND "hubbuy_accounts"."reconciled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "hubbuy_accounts"."reconciled_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("hubbuy_accounts"."status" != 'active')

hubbuy_balance_entry_basis.name: hubbuy_balance_entry_basis
hubbuy_balance_entry_basis.value: "hubbuy_balance_entries"."historical_brl_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("hubbuy_balance_entries"."historical_brl_cents") = 'integer' AND "hubbuy_balance_entries"."historical_brl_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000)

qc_external_quantity.name: qc_external_quantity
qc_external_quantity.value: "hubbuy_external_items"."quantity" IS NULL OR (typeof("hubbuy_external_items"."quantity") = 'integer' AND "hubbuy_external_items"."quantity" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

member_financing_settlement.name: member_financing_settlement
member_financing_settlement.value: ("member_balance_financing_entries"."settled_amount_cents" IS NULL AND "member_balance_financing_entries"."settled_currency" IS NULL) OR (typeof("member_balance_financing_entries"."settled_amount_cents") = 'integer' AND "member_balance_financing_entries"."settled_amount_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND "member_balance_financing_entries"."settled_currency" IN ('BRL','CNY'))

cost_charge_package_scope.name: cost_charge_package_scope
cost_charge_package_scope.value: ("purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" = 'products' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."package_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."value_state" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" IN ('brazil_freight','customs') AND "purchase_cost_charges"."package_id" IS NOT NULL)

cost_charge_value_state.name: cost_charge_value_state
cost_charge_value_state.value: "purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" = 'products' OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."value_state" = 'known' AND typeof("purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000) OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."value_state" IN ('pending','no_charge') AND "purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents" IS NULL)

cost_charge_fee.name: cost_charge_fee
cost_charge_fee.value: ("purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."payment_method" IS NULL) OR (typeof("purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "purchase_cost_charges"."payment_method" IN ('pix','card'))

cost_charge_customs_fee.name: cost_charge_customs_fee
cost_charge_customs_fee.value: "purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" != 'customs' OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."payment_method" IS NULL)

cost_charge_paid.name: cost_charge_paid
cost_charge_paid.value: ("purchase_cost_charges"."payment_status" = 'pending' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_by" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."payment_status" = 'paid' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL)

cost_refund_participant_shares.name: cost_refund_participant_shares
cost_refund_participant_shares.value: typeof("purchase_cost_refund_participants"."original_product_share_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refund_participants"."original_product_share_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND typeof("purchase_cost_refund_participants"."original_china_share_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refund_participants"."original_china_share_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND typeof("purchase_cost_refund_participants"."original_product_fee_share_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refund_participants"."original_product_fee_share_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000

cost_refund_requested_amounts.name: cost_refund_requested_amounts
cost_refund_requested_amounts.value: typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."requested_product_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."requested_product_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."requested_china_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."requested_china_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."requested_product_cents" + "purchase_cost_refunds"."requested_china_cents" > 0

cost_refund_received_state.name: cost_refund_received_state
cost_refund_received_state.value: ("purchase_cost_refunds"."status" = 'requested' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_product_cents" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_china_cents" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_by" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_refunds"."status" IN ('received','voided') AND (("purchase_cost_refunds"."received_product_cents" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_china_cents" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_by" IS NULL) OR (typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."received_product_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_product_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."received_china_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_china_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."received_by" IS NOT NULL)))

cost_refund_void_state.name: cost_refund_void_state
cost_refund_void_state.value: ("purchase_cost_refunds"."status" = 'voided' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("purchase_cost_refunds"."void_reason")) > 0) OR ("purchase_cost_refunds"."status" != 'voided' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."void_reason" IS NULL)

cost_refund_original_values.name: cost_refund_original_values
cost_refund_original_values.value: typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."original_item_quantity") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."original_item_quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."original_product_unit_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."original_product_unit_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."original_china_unit_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."original_china_unit_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000

cost_refund_fee_snapshot.name: cost_refund_fee_snapshot
cost_refund_fee_snapshot.value: ("purchase_cost_refunds"."original_payment_method" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."original_fee_bps" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_refunds"."original_payment_method" IN ('pix','card') AND typeof("purchase_cost_refunds"."original_fee_bps") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_refunds"."original_fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

cost_tracking_state.name: cost_tracking_state
cost_tracking_state.value: ("purchase_cost_trackings"."status" = 'open' AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_by" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_trackings"."status" = 'closed' AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL)

cost_item_effective_price_state.name: cost_item_effective_price_state
cost_item_effective_price_state.value: ("purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_state" = 'known' AND typeof("purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_unit_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_unit_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000) OR ("purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_state" IN ('pending','no_charge') AND "purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_unit_cents" IS NULL)

cost_item_china_freight_state.name: cost_item_china_freight_state
cost_item_china_freight_state.value: ("purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_state" = 'known' AND typeof("purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_unit_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_unit_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000) OR ("purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_state" IN ('pending','no_charge') AND "purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_unit_cents" IS NULL)

item_participant_percentage.name: item_participant_percentage
item_participant_percentage.value: "purchase_item_participants"."percentage_bps" IS NULL OR (typeof("purchase_item_participants"."percentage_bps") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_participants"."percentage_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

item_participant_amount.name: item_participant_amount
item_participant_amount.value: "purchase_item_participants"."amount_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("purchase_item_participants"."amount_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_participants"."amount_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000)

purchase_finalized_date.name: purchase_finalized_date
purchase_finalized_date.value: ("purchases"."status" = 'active' AND "purchases"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("purchases"."status" = 'finalized' AND "purchases"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

qc_preview_state.name: qc_preview_state
qc_preview_state.value: ("qc_image_previews"."status" = 'deleted' AND "qc_image_previews"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "qc_image_previews"."delete_state" IN ('pending','deleted')) OR ("qc_image_previews"."status" != 'deleted' AND "qc_image_previews"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "qc_image_previews"."delete_state" = 'none')

qc_preview_ready.name: qc_preview_ready
qc_preview_ready.value: "qc_image_previews"."status" != 'ready' OR ("qc_image_previews"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND typeof("qc_image_previews"."byte_size") = 'integer' AND "qc_image_previews"."byte_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 131072 AND typeof("qc_image_previews"."width") = 'integer' AND "qc_image_previews"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND typeof("qc_image_previews"."height") = 'integer' AND "qc_image_previews"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 160)

qc_source_budget.name: qc_source_budget
qc_source_budget.value: typeof("qc_image_sources"."bytes_reserved") = 'integer' AND "qc_image_sources"."bytes_reserved" BETWEEN 0 AND 8388608 AND typeof("qc_image_sources"."bytes_consumed") = 'integer' AND "qc_image_sources"."bytes_consumed" BETWEEN 0 AND 209715200

qc_image_state.name: qc_image_state
qc_image_state.value: ("qc_images"."status" = 'deleted' AND "qc_images"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "qc_images"."deleted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "qc_images"."delete_state" IN ('pending','deleted')) OR ("qc_images"."status" != 'deleted' AND "qc_images"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "qc_images"."deleted_by" IS NULL AND "qc_images"."delete_state" = 'none')

qc_image_ready.name: qc_image_ready
qc_image_ready.value: "qc_images"."status" != 'ready' OR ("qc_images"."content_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "qc_images"."mime_type" IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp') AND typeof("qc_images"."byte_size") = 'integer' AND "qc_images"."byte_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608 AND typeof("qc_images"."width") = 'integer' AND "qc_images"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND typeof("qc_images"."height") = 'integer' AND "qc_images"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 8192)

qc_import_bytes.name: qc_import_bytes
qc_import_bytes.value: typeof("qc_imports"."bytes_reserved") = 'integer' AND "qc_imports"."bytes_reserved" BETWEEN 0 AND 209715200 AND typeof("qc_imports"."bytes_consumed") = 'integer' AND "qc_imports"."bytes_consumed" BETWEEN 0 AND 209715200
